plan.title: Enable vendor masking on live auction

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen for an auction.
a priced single-stage event needs its type set before a template (the screen opens as RFP)
Apply the first available auction template.
Add a line item required for the auction.
Invite two participating vendors as required by the setup.
Publish the auction so it is live.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Open the event Actions menu where Vendor Masking can be enabled.
Enable vendor masking for the live auction.
Verify the first participating vendor is represented by the Vendor 1 alias.
Verify the second participating vendor is represented by the Vendor 2 alias.
